task.description:
WF-02, CODE-FIXER after a FAIL at step 4 — fix the code of REQ-104 by the findings of the two gates. Read their results yourself: handoffs/E2E104-20261103-01/step-04-reviewer.json (REVIEWER: FAIL) and handoffs/E2E104-20261103-01/step-03-security-reviewer.json (SECURITY-REVIEWER: PASS with Low findings). The numbering "R-F1..R-F8" = findings of the REVIEWER, "S-F1..S-F6" = findings of the SECURITY-REVIEWER.
MUST FIX (blocking): R-F1 High (runner.js:342 prints only the first line of every E2eError: print the full message, keep the cut only for INTERNAL) and R-F2 Medium (cdp.js:167 connect() has no time limit on the WebSocket handshake: apply callTimeoutMs to the open; the preflight must not hang).
ALSO FIX (cheap Low items, ORCH decision, so that step 5 can test them): R-F3 dead code ERROR_CODES/usage() (remove or use), R-F4 group-kill helpers written twice (one shared helper), R-F5 waitFor must not hide PROTOCOL_ERROR in the timeout text, R-F6 the stderr 'close' branch that never fires (START_EXITED takes about 0.4 s: make it fire), R-F7 a screenshot write failure must not be coded USAGE, R-F8 (the 100 ms settle is now recorded in the Addendum of decisions/0108 — no code change); S-F1 the runner must keep a registry of the browsers its spec started and kill them (with their profile folders) after a stop or a hung spec, as tools/README.md says; S-F2 escape control characters and a line start "::" in page/browser text that goes into errors and the log, cut each piece, cap the number of listed entries; S-F3 add the Chrome argument --no-proxy-server (decisions/0108 Addendum) — and keep the argument list in the design section where it is listed consistent (tell ORCH in result.issues which design lines now differ, DOC-UPDATER will carry them); S-F4 a NUL character, an over-long name or a link loop in a path must give PATH_REFUSED, not a raw Node error. S-F5 (frame-size limit) and S-F6 are NOT to be done (Info).
RULES: change only what the findings name; do not weaken anything; do not edit the six old guard tests or write tests of the kit (TEST-DESIGNER writes them at step 5 — leave your own probes outside the project); keep the words forbidden by the design out of every file under tools/test/e2e (sandbox flags, skip words) comments included; format with `cd tools && npx prettier --write <your files>`; `npm run lint`; self-check `cd tools && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run traces && npm run handoffs-check`, plus your probes of each fix (R-F1, R-F2 with a TCP server that never upgrades, S-F1 with a blocked spec, S-F2 with a page that prints "::error" lines, S-F4). No full `npm test` more than once (the six guard tests stay red until step 5 — name exactly which). Mac: one agent at a time, kill Chrome you start by process id, remove only your own temp folders, never rm inside the project. Do not commit. In result.changes: every edit with the finding number; in result.issues: what step 5 must test because of these fixes.
acceptance_criteria: R-F1 and R-F2 fixed with a probe each
Every other listed finding fixed or an honest reason in issues

result.summary: All findings R-F1..R-F7 and S-F1..S-F4 fixed in the write set; R-F8 needs no code; S-F5, S-F6 not done by order. R-F1 (full E2eError text) and R-F2 (time limit on the WebSocket open) each have a probe with the before and after output. Real Chrome 156 and the stand-in were used; every Chrome I started is gone, my temp folders removed. The six old guard tests are red as before (not touched). Tests of the kit are not written (step 5).

changes.change: an E2eError is printed with its whole message (`e2e: error=<code>: <message>`); the first-line cut stays only for INTERNAL (and INTERNAL text goes through safeText)

the open of the WebSocket has the limit callTimeoutMs; on expiry the socket is closed and CALL_TIMEOUT `connect: no answer in <ms> ms` is thrown; launchBrowser then kills the group and removes the folder, so the preflight of runAll cannot hang
new mode `no-upgrade`: prints the port line, accepts the connection, never answers the upgrade (for the step-5 test)
both removed (no user in tools/; the table of codes stays in the design 4.1)
one set of group helpers (signalGroup, waitGroupGone, stopGroup) in cleanup.js; the two private copies in browser.js and runner.js removed; Browser.close, abortStart and the runner use them
the last swallowed PROTOCOL_ERROR is kept and appended to the WAIT_TIMEOUT text: `; last protocol error: <message>`

waits for the child's own `close` event (process ended and stderr read) instead of a stderr `close` that had already happened; the 300 ms timer stays for a helper holding the pipe; START_EXITED now ~60 ms instead of ~380 ms
a write failure is coded SCREENSHOT_FAILED (new code, was USAGE); the repeated `failure !== null &&` removed
no code change (recorded in the Addendum of decisions/0108)

issues.text: DESIGN LINES that now differ (DOC-UPDATER carries them, decisions/0108 Addendum covers S-F2/S-F3/100 ms): (a) S-F3: section 4.6 step 3 (line ~214: the argument list gets `--no-proxy-server` between `--disable-gpu` and the resolver rule; the words `No other flag` still hold for the sandbox); E2K-25 (line ~450: the list that the stand-in records and the test compares); the sentence of section 0 / C-4 (lines ~17, 78) and fact F23 (line ~51) may name the proxy flag; mutant table: a mutant `--no-proxy-server dropped` could be added near M44. (b) R-F2: section 4.5 line ~185: `connect` now also rejects CALL_TIMEOUT (`connect: no answer in <ms> ms`) when the upgrade is not answered in callTimeoutMs; section 5 table: new stand-in mode `no-upgrade`. (c) R-F7: section 4.1 table: new code SCREENSHOT_FAILED (`Page.screenshot: could not write "<path>": <system code>`, thrown by Page.screenshot); PATH_REFUSED line ~138: new reason `not a usable path` (NUL, over-long name, link loop). (d) S-F2: section 4.1 / 7: page and browser text in messages goes through safeText (escape, cut, leading `::`), CONSOLE_ENTRIES lists at most 20 + 20 entries; `E2eError.message` of CONSOLE_ENTRIES differs from the earlier unlimited list. (e) S-F1: sections 4.4 and 6: the registry of browsers (variable SAI_E2E_REGISTRY, files <pgid>.json, sweep after each spec/at stop/at exit); this makes `no process left` true after a hung or blocked spec; the residual O7 (SIGKILL of the runner itself) is unchanged. (f) R-F5: section 4.8 waitFor row: the WAIT_TIMEOUT text may end with `; last protocol error: <message>`. (g) R-F3: section 4.1: the module no longer exports ERROR_CODES and usage; a test that wants to pin the table keeps its own list. tools/README.md: no sentence became untrue (line 842 'cannot reach any other address' and 'removed ... on a failure' are now truer); not edited.

Same kind, outside the list, not edited (AP-014 / AP-019): (1) guards.js tempRoot() (realpath of os.tmpdir()) throws a raw ENOENT when TMPDIR points to a missing folder; used by makeTempDir, assertUnderTempRoot, assertShotPath - an environment fault, not a path argument, so left. (2) runner.js `e2e: command=... selection=...` prints the operator's argv raw (I4 of SECURITY-REVIEWER; the argument is refused as SELECTION_UNKNOWN anyway).
